property_summary: Calling SetMinSum should succeed (not revert) when no initialization call has been made that sets the contract into a state that forbids first-time MinSum setup (i.e., SetMinSum must be callable before Initialized is called).
change_summary: Change SetMinSum to only allow setting MinSum once by making it revert unless not initialized (i.e., invert the existing condition to force revert when not initialized), effectively preventing the first call from setting MinSum.
